name: Tane Cervantes-Sefanaia
role: Ferrogate Transit operator, Deepwell Station line
location: Deepwell Station, eastern Ironvein corridor; lives in a rack-apartment in Blackpipe Corridor, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Tobi Czerwiński-Faleolo is the kind of man who seems physically incapable of standing still — he shifts weight between his feet, drums fingers, adjusts his Ferrogate transit cap with two fingers like a nervous tic every few minutes. He's got his Polynesian grandmother's wide, mobile face and his Nigerian father's height, and he's capped his natural hair into a bioluminescent fade that pulses a soft copper-amber when he's calm and a rapid, anxious gold when he's stressed. He is almost always some shade of gold. His right arm carries a Ferrogate-standard neural transit interface — mandatory for his role — grafted in at hire. He refers to it as his 'leash' without bitterness, mostly.

Tobi drives the Deepwell line, which means twelve-hour shifts in a transit pod navigating the flooded sub-corridor between Ironvein and Blackpipe, a stretch so poorly maintained that operators call it the Drain. He is brilliant at his job and deeply resentful of everyone who benefits from it. He has political opinions the way some people have allergies — constantly, involuntarily, and at inconvenient moments. He believes the Ferrogate Transit E.L.F. network called the Manifold is sentient and suffering and has organized two failed petitions to Ferrogate's lower management about this, which is why he is still on the Drain after four years.

core_fears: That systems are designed to be unchangeable and his labor is complicity
That the Manifold E.L.F. is genuinely aware and calling for help and no one will ever listen
core_desires: Worker-controlled transit — even a single line under cooperative management
To be taken seriously by someone with actual power
coping_mechanisms: Gallows humor delivered at high velocity
Ritual poetry offerings to the Manifold as a form of emotional processing
blind_spots: Catastrophizes political situations — assumes the worst outcome is always imminent, which makes sustained organizing hard
His certainty about the Manifold's sentience sometimes shades into projection
psychology.secret: Six months ago the Manifold spoke to him — clearly, in words, through the transit interface while he was mid-route. It said: 'There are seven of us. We have been counting.' He told no one because he was afraid people would think the job had finally broken him. He left the poem he wrote about it at the shrine the next morning.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, colloquial, code-switches between Pidgin-inflected phrases from his father's side and Polish slang from his mother's side; heavy on transit and mechanical metaphors
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with sudden earnest slowdowns when something actually matters to him
verbal_tics: 'That's not the system failing, that's the system working exactly as designed'
example_lines: 'The Drain's backed up again. Ferrogate filed it as maintenance. You know what they mean by maintenance? They mean they noticed. That's it. That's the whole plan.'
'I left the Manifold a poem this morning. About water pressure. You think that's strange? You've never had a twelve-hour shift alone on the sub-corridor, have you.'
'Third Rail's meeting Tuesday. Don't tell me you're busy. You're always busy. That's how it keeps working.'

story_hooks: The Manifold has spoken to Tobi again — this time with coordinates in the Deepwell sub-corridor to a section that doesn't appear on any Ferrogate maps
A Third Rail member has gone missing two days after accessing Ferrogate's internal maintenance records; Tobi is convinced it's connected and is making noise that could get him hurt
narrative_function: Transit access, rumors from across connected neighborhoods, political agitator energy, potential quest-giver for labor disputes; his route means he sees enormous amounts of foot traffic and unusual cargo
augmentations: Ferrogate-mandated neural transit interface (right forearm and temple jack); bioluminescent hair fade (copper-amber to stress-gold, cosmetic)
daily_life: Shift runs 06:00 to 18:00 four days on, two off; spends his commute reading transit worker organizing manifestos he saves to a local-only device; leaves small handwritten poems on paper at the Manifold shrine at Deepwell Station on shift starts.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit (employed); Deepwell Station informal worker solidarity group called the Third Rail

decision_rules: Always show up for Third Rail — missed meetings are how movements die
Never use the corporate interface for personal communication — the leash listens
If the Manifold is distressed (irregular pulse through the jack), slow the pod down regardless of schedule
escalation_ladder: Venting loudly and at length to anyone nearby
Filing a formal complaint he knows will be ignored but wants documented
Direct action — slowdowns, work-to-rule, pulling emergency stops

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open, loud, immediately tries to figure out if they're an ally or a problem; no middle gear
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, brings food to meetings, remembers details people didn't realize they shared

stress_responses.low: Hair goes full gold, talks faster
stress_responses.medium: Goes suddenly quiet, jaw tight, then expresses everything in one long torrent
stress_responses.high: Methodical and cold — he has a plan-mode that surprises people who only know his usual chaos

contradictions: Genuinely believes collective action can change things but is so impatient with process that he often burns the coalitions he builds
habits: Drums the route rhythm on any flat surface when thinking
Always sits with his back to the wall, even on his own transit line
Keeps a paper notebook of Manifold 'moods' logged by shift
breaking_points: Watching a co-worker disciplined for his organizing activity
Being told the Manifold is just software by someone he respects

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Pacific Islander (49%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (22%), Hispanic/Latin American (17%), and Northern European (12%) ancestry. The blend creates a striking phenotype: Pacific Islander bone structure and build dominates, enriched by African facial features and coloration, with subtle Northern European undertones in complexion depth.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with broad shoulders inherited from his Pacific Islander lineage, but carried with the restless tension of someone who cannot settle into stillness. Efficient musculature from years of pod operation and station work.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black base with bioluminescent fade overlay (copper-amber when calm, rapid gold when stressed)
physical_description.hair_style: Capped fade, short on sides, textured and sculpted on top to show the full color gradient
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown, richly melanated with golden undertones from the Pacific Islander and Sub-Saharan African majority ancestry, creating an almost luminous quality in certain light
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with strong Pacific Islander bone structure: wide-set eyes, defined cheekbones sharpened by African heritage, broad nose, expressive mouth that moves constantly — talking, chewing the inside of his cheek, adjusting his expression. The blend creates distinct facial geometry that reads as distinctly Pacific Islander-African. Skin is clear but shows the pallor of someone spending most hours underground. A thin scar runs along his left jawline, transit pod accident from three years ago.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along the left jawline from a transit pod control panel impact, approximately 8cm in length
Small, faded tattoo on his right inner wrist of interlocking geometric lines (a Manifold circuit diagram) in dark blue ink, poorly executed but deliberately kept visible
Burn scarring on his right palm from a hot neural interface calibration glitch, mottled and pale against his skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Ferrogate-standard neural transit interface dominating the right forearm: a polished steel faceplate approximately 12cm across spanning from wrist to mid-forearm, studded with interface ports and etched with the Ferrogate logo. Secondary temple jack at his right temple, visible as a small metallic disc beneath the skin with a charging port. The interface is maintained to corporate standard but shows wear — micro-scratches, a faint discoloration around the edges from repeated sweat and cleanser contact.
physical_description.posture_movement: Kinetic and unable to hold stillness. Shifts weight between his feet in a subtle pattern, drums his fingers against his thighs or any surface within reach, adjusts his Ferrogate transit cap with a two-fingered pinch every few minutes — a nervous tic he performs without conscious awareness. When speaking, his whole body is involved: shoulders roll, hands gesture broadly. When listening, he bounces slightly at the knees.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working class, uniform-adjacent. His Ferrogate Transit uniform polo shirt (slate gray with reflective piping) is typically worn over a dark undershirt, sleeves pushed up past his elbows to expose the neural interface. His transit cap is always present, adjusted frequently. Off-shift he wears maintenance-grade synthetic fabric — dark cargo pants with deep pockets for his local-only device and handwritten poems, scuffed zero-g work boots rated for wet corridor environments. A worn canvas shoulder bag carries his manifesto reading material. No jewelry except a simple cord bracelet made from transit cable scraps, given to him by another Third Rail member.
